title: Madeline McIntosh (Authors Equity co-founder, ex-Penguin Random House US CEO) surfaces the Adam Grant + Greg McKeown episodes
summary: Madeline McIntosh — Incorruptible's publisher at Authors Equity and former CEO of Penguin Random House US — signal-boosts the Adam Grant Re:Thinking and Greg McKeown Show episodes from her personal LinkedIn.
blockquote: Did you think that peak summer would keep me from talking about fighting corporate corruption the INCORRUPTIBLE way? You thought wrong. Two great new podcast conversations just landed: Eric Ries chatting with Adam Grant and Greg McKeown.
